purpose: Empty photographic ikebana backdrops with subtle dawn and dusk colour

images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: square empty photographic backdrop for an interactive Japanese ikebana studio. Generate a completely EMPTY seamless studio cyclorama, seen straight-on at tabletop height; absolutely no flowers, plants, vase, props, text, logo, or watermark. A real fine-art studio photograph, calm and refined, smooth matte photographic paper, almost imperceptible fine grain, no plaster texture, no stone, no fabric, no brushstrokes. A subtle horizontal ground plane occupies bottom 20 percent, with a very soft curved transition into wall at about 80 percent height, NOT a sharp table edge. Perspective completely frontal, no corners. Soft broad off-camera light from upper left; extremely gentle broad photographic light falloff across empty wall. Keep central 75 percent clear, smooth and quietly luminous for compositing real flowers. A dreamlike '霞' atmosphere expressed as faint color in the light, not clouds, scenery, fog, visible light rays or bokeh. Color must be subtle and restrained, depth through realistic light alone. No baked shadow of an absent object. Full bleed, 1536 by 1536 square. Palette: luminous warm ivory at the upper left, a whisper of pale apricot and rose-gold dusk on the right, pearl beige around the floor, a very faint lavender countertone at extreme right. Airy high key, graceful warm afterglow. Softer and cleaner than a textured wall, premium ikebana catalog photography.
